questions.question: If South-East becomes North, North-East becomes West and so on, what will South-West become?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/589439c1d7bd58ca99af1697d1cbc88ca5e362283a0cca4e6592fa073c8a19c5.png] 

Let the angle between South – East and North – East be 90⁰.

Rotation of South – East by 135⁰ (90⁰ + 45⁰) gives North.

Rotation of North – East by 135⁰ gives West.

Similarly, rotation of South – West by 135⁰ gives **East**.

Hence, the correct answer is ‘**East**’.

questions.question:
Sunil drives 5 km from point A towards the west. He then takes a left turn and drives 6 km. He again takes a left turn and drives 11 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 6 km. He finally takes a right turn and drives 6 km to arrive at point B. How much and in which direction does he have to drive to return to point A?

(All the turns are 90° turns only.)
questions.solution:
According to the given information,

1) Sunil drives 5 km from point A towards the west.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/350be3af6e23cbb0066bd11cd920f443c0c09db420bc08efc656c5ac548aaa74.png] 

2) He then takes a left turn and drives 6 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b15e69b853e16060e61ce577e14c67d31656cd36b8329975883a9924ff71ed69.png] 

3) He again takes a left turn and drives 11 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 6 km.

4) He finally takes a right turn and drives 6 km to arrive at point B. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcdc9af5c15144b4c3c72c96de52f75904a0aee3cf37a02627737158568a7de1.png] 

Here, we can see that he has to drive in west direction to return to point A.

Distance between A and B = (6 + 6) = 12 km

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
